title: Standalone Model Parameters Create Response
description: 201 body of POST /api/v1/model-parameters. BARE (not the success envelope): the handler returns `jsonify(response), 201` where `response` is built literally at src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:298-317. `model_parameters_routes` is classified bare in success_envelope_schema.json#/x-wrap-map. Field names are camelCase at the top level and snake_case inside each item — that asymmetry is what the code emits, not a transcription error.

modelParametersId.description: Id of the FIRST created row only (`created[0].id`) — not a collection id, and not a handle to the other rows when the request created several.

modelParameters.description: One entry per created row, in request order.

frequency_penalty.description: Never null in this response: the ModelParameters constructor substitutes agents/model_parameters_schema.json's declared `default` when the request omits the optional (src/models/model_parameters.py:92-109), so an omitted `frequencyPenalty` is persisted and echoed as 0.2.

presence_penalty.description: Never null in this response: the ModelParameters constructor substitutes agents/model_parameters_schema.json's declared `default` when the request omits the optional (src/models/model_parameters.py:92-109), so an omitted `presencePenalty` is persisted and echoed as 0.2.

top_k.description: Never null in this response: the ModelParameters constructor substitutes agents/model_parameters_schema.json's declared `default` when the request omits the optional (src/models/model_parameters.py:92-109), so an omitted `topK` is persisted and echoed as 50.

repetition_penalty.description: Never null in this response: the ModelParameters constructor substitutes agents/model_parameters_schema.json's declared `default` when the request omits the optional (src/models/model_parameters.py:92-109), so an omitted `repetitionPenalty` is persisted and echoed as 0.2.

stop_sequences.description: Always null from this route: nothing sets it and agents/model_parameters_schema.json declares the default as null (src/models/model_parameters.py:110-114, 130-134). The key is always present (src/routes/model_parameters_routes.py:312).
